name: M3_MMS200MI_GetItmPrice
description: Retrieve price-related master data for a single item in a company. The operation returns the item’s current purchase and sales price setup, including purchase price unit of measure, price quantities, currencies, costing models, discount and bonus groups, VAT codes, and main supplier information. It also returns user-defined accounting control data, statistics identities, and audit information such as last change date and price change dates. When a language code is supplied, description fields are populated so you see readable texts for units, currencies, and pricing groups in that language instead of only codes.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for which price data is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which the item price data is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: LNCD
inputParameters.description: Language code used when retrieving any price-related descriptions.

outputParameters.name: PPUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase price is expressed.

outputParameters.name: DS01
outputParameters.description: Description of the purchase price unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: ECCC
outputParameters.description: Consumption code used for trade statistics for this item.

outputParameters.name: WSCA
outputParameters.description: Costing model used to calculate purchase costs for the item.

outputParameters.name: PRGP
outputParameters.description: Procurement group used to classify the item for purchasing.

outputParameters.name: ACRF
outputParameters.description: User-defined accounting control object connected to the item for accounting control.

outputParameters.name: PRCM
outputParameters.description: Product costing model used to calculate the item's product cost.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Main supplier number associated with the item.

outputParameters.name: SUNM
outputParameters.description: Name of the main supplier for the item.

outputParameters.name: PUPR
outputParameters.description: Purchase price for the item for the stated quantity and currency.

outputParameters.name: PUCD
outputParameters.description: Quantity to which the purchase price applies.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency of the purchase price.

outputParameters.name: DS02
outputParameters.description: Description of the purchase price currency.

outputParameters.name: SAPR
outputParameters.description: Sales price for the item for the stated quantity and currency.

outputParameters.name: SACD
outputParameters.description: Quantity to which the sales price applies.

outputParameters.name: CUCS
outputParameters.description: Currency of the sales price.

outputParameters.name: DS03
outputParameters.description: Description of the sales price currency.

outputParameters.name: DIGI
outputParameters.description: Item discount group used when calculating customer order line discounts.

outputParameters.name: DS04
outputParameters.description: Description of the item discount group.

outputParameters.name: BGRP
outputParameters.description: Bonus group used when defining bonus item and customer agreements.

outputParameters.name: DS05
outputParameters.description: Description of the bonus group.

outputParameters.name: PRVG
outputParameters.description: Commission group used when defining commission and bonus agreements for the item.

outputParameters.name: DS06
outputParameters.description: Description of the commission group.

outputParameters.name: FRE3
outputParameters.description: Statistics identity 3 used for accumulating item sales statistics.

outputParameters.name: FRE4
outputParameters.description: Statistics identity 4 used for accumulating item sales statistics.

outputParameters.name: OTDI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item value is included in the basis for total order discounts.

outputParameters.name: BOGR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item line generates or pays bonus according to bonus agreements.

outputParameters.name: SPUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure on which the sales price is based.

outputParameters.name: DS07
outputParameters.description: Description of the sales price unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: SPUC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the sales price unit of measure is fixed or dynamically determined.

outputParameters.name: VTCP
outputParameters.description: VAT code used for purchase transactions of this item.

outputParameters.name: VTCS
outputParameters.description: VAT code used for sales transactions of this item.

outputParameters.name: SAPB
outputParameters.description: Sales price per basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the item price data was last changed.

outputParameters.name: PDCC
outputParameters.description: Number of decimal places used when displaying or entering prices for the item.

outputParameters.name: PPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the purchase price was last entered or changed.

outputParameters.name: SPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the sales price was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number identifying the latest change sequence for the item master.
